No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result First Niger Bridge: South-South Must Reward Tinubu By Voting For Him – Umahi by LEADERSHIP News 9 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Federal Government has reopened the First Niger Bridge for vehicular movement after 38 days of closure for emergency rehabilitation works.
The Minister of Works, Senator David Umahi, who led a Federal Government delegation to reopen the bridge on Thursday, formally said the swift completion of the repair works underscores President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s commitment to preserving critical national infrastructure and ensuring the safety of Nigerians.
Umahi, while addressing journalists at the bridgehead, said the closure became necessary to carry out comprehensive maintenance on the bridge.
Speaking at the reopening ceremony, Umahi praised President Bola Tinubu’s infrastructure interventions in South-South, urging residents of the regions to reciprocate by supporting his re-election bid in 2027.
He also cautioned content creators who seek counsel without knowledge to desist from unverifiable smear attacks
He also clarified the status of the East-West Road, as the government has ordered full-blown construction on the road that spans all through the South-South states
Road users praised President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s infrastructural drive as they commended the honourable minister for his Good work
